body.statement: The explicitly dimensioned construction \((\Gamma^{\star},P^{\star})\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(3)}(3,8)\). For every \(h\in\{0,1,2\}^3\), all conditional probabilities are strictly positive; the third latent coordinate has no pure child; and the displayed selected matrices satisfy \(\det(B_{a,k,u})=(c^{\star}_{s(a,k),\rho_a(k)})^2>0\). Thus \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}>0\), the same properties persist on a relatively open neighborhood in the positive table space, and \(\mathcal R(P_X^{\star})\) is identified.
body.justification: The witness demonstrates a positive no-pure-child ternary region and makes every certificate matrix inspectable.
body.gap: Lee and Gu (2026) give binary no-pure-child examples and ternary failures, but no positive certified ternary model supporting the full chain.
body.consumer: It is an exact regression test and simulation fixture for a \(\texttt{cdmTools}\)-style checker.
